remarks: A rare opportunity to live in a granite and limestone estate of historic significance, just moments from the heart of downtown New Canaan. Set on three beautifully landscaped acres, Stepping Stones is a distinguished residence of only eight bespoke condominiums, showcasing exceptional period craftsmanship including soaring ceilings, European millwork, and Hope steel windows. This turnkey residence spans two floors and blends timeless architecture with refined updates. Highlights include antique plank floors, a custom Deane kitchen and a gracious south-facing living room with wood-burning fireplace. A recently finished all-season conservatory opens to an expansive private stone terrace, ideal for year-round dining and entertaining. The second floor offers two spacious en-suite bedrooms, including a primary suite with fireplace, dressing area, and generous closets. The third bedroom has been thoughtfully redesigned as a beautiful office.  Additional features include in-unit laundry and private storage within the building. Enjoy estate-like grounds with the ease of a professionally managed property, all just minutes to the train, village center, Irwin Park, library, shops, and restaurants. A truly special in-town New Canaan offering.
